content: Chatwoot Dashboard Apps deliver conversation/contact context to an embedded iframe via postMessage (listens for 'chatwoot-dashboard-app:fetch-info'). Historically no built-in authentication — just name+URL — and the browser (not Chatwoot server) makes the request to the app. CVE-2025-12245: origin validation error in initPostMessageCommunication (IFrameHelper.js), Chatwoot 4.0-4.7.0, allows spoofed postMessage communication. Separately reported: unvalidated postMessage handler + non-expiring cw_conversation token enabling session hijack. Must validate event.origin explicitly and confirm CVE patched before trusting Dashboard Apps with real customer/booking data.
